channel.title: hix tools — writing
channel.description: Seven practical deep dives into the checks that normally depend on someone remembering: env drift, dangerous migrations, contract breaks, workflow risk, Compose red flags, agent remote control, and star velocity — plus the hix runner that ties the CLI tools together.

item.title: 16 things to check in your GitHub Actions workflows
item.description: ActionLens turns any GitHub Actions YAML into a job graph, real matrix size, token permissions, and a 16-rule security review.

item.title: Docker Compose red flags before you deploy
item.description: ComposeMap turns a Docker Compose file into a service graph and a plain-English risk review, entirely in your browser.

item.title: Catching env var drift before it breaks prod
item.description: EnvAudit scans a repo for env vars that are missing, undocumented, unused, or exposed as secrets — and fails CI when code and configuration disagree.

item.title: Static SQL migration analysis without a database
item.description: Migration Guard parses SQL and flags destructive statements, blocking DDL, and breaking renames statically — no database connection needed.

item.title: Breaking API changes you didn't know you shipped
item.description: API Watch diffs OpenAPI specs against a local baseline and classifies every change as breaking or safe, with CI-ready exit codes.

item.title: Momentum, not stars: ranking GitHub repos by acceleration
item.description: RepoRace ranks GitHub repositories by acceleration, not raw stars — momentum and breakout leaderboards backed by local SQLite.

item.title: Remote-controlling OpenCode from Telegram
item.description: OpenCode Telegram puts a local OpenCode server in your pocket: streaming replies, session switching, and permission approvals from your phone.
